candidates.title: [Bug] DeepSeek-V4 HiCache: SWA host pool is sized from the small SWA device pool, so idle prefixes miss the host tier long before the KV host pool fills
candidates.snippet: ### Describe the bug  On DeepSeek-V4 with HiCache, the SWA host pool is sized as `device_swa_pages * hicache_ratio`. The SWA device pool is fixed and small: 362,240 tokens on our setup, regardless of `--mem-fraction-static`. As a result, the SWA host pool, about 724K tokens at ratio 2, fills long before the full-KV host pool does.
